sn27.10:1.2: yo bhikkhave, rūpasmiṃ chandarāgo, cittasse’so upakkileso. yo vedanāya chandarāgo …pe… yo saññāya chandarāgo …pe… yo saṅkhāresu chandarāgo …pe… yo viññāṇasmiṃ chandarāgo, cittasse’so upakkileso.
sn27.10:1.3: yato kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno imesu pañcasu ṭhānesu cetaso upakkileso pahīno hoti, nekkhammaninnaṃ cassa cittaṃ hoti.
sn27.10:1.4: nekkhammaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ kammaniyaṃ khāyati, abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesūti.
